what: When the cursor is over a product card, a second photo stacked in the photo slot (another angle or a worn shot) turns on in .3s while the first fades out over the same duration. It switches per card wherever the cursor is on the card, and reverses on release. On devices without a pointer the first photo stays.

options.[data-fx-part=frame] > [data-fx-part=mai: Photo frame with the first and second photos overlapping inside — the second photo is laid absolute so it fully covers the frame
options.--fx-main-out: Opacity of the first photo on hover (via style), default 0 — if the second photo is a cut-out (transparent background), set it to 1 so the two overlap
options.--fx-zoom / --fx-zoom-dur / --fx-zoom-ea: While hovered, the second photo zooms in — scale, length and curve set via style — default 1 (no zoom) · 1.5s · cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) (1.05 for pixel-cursor-mockup-shop)
options.--fx-from: Scale of the second photo while at rest (via style), default 1. Give 1.2 with --fx-zoom: 1 and it settles from 1.2 to 1 and switches on when hovered (brand-cat-jp-ja)

from.where: index.html .bu-prod (product card in the all-umbrellas horizontal row — original group-hover:opacity-0 / opacity-100, transition-opacity duration-300)
index.html·about.html·works.html first work card — original page-builder ‹mouseover image›: on hover the first photo switches off immediately (duration 0) and the second photo shows → --fx-dur: 0s
index.css .pv-pcard — original product-card--has-hover-image: on hover the front cutout turns off immediately and the back cutout turns on (no transition). The price band .4s ease belongs to the site

shared.css .ib-card (gray cell in the product row) — original ProductCard hasHoverImage: on hover the cutout switches instantly (no transition) to the worn or foot shot (covers the cell, leaving 2rem blank below) and the tag text turns white via difference. The tag inversion is on the site side.
index.css product card .vs-card (index · shop) — the second scene turns on immediately and zooms in to 1.05 over 1.5s

shared.css .ac-card (all product cards — original p_hover__thumbnail: the second photo turns on over .5s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) and both photos scale to 1.16. Scaling of the first photo is handled on the site side)

shared.js .kc-card (product card — original Product card hover: second photo scale 1.2→1 · opacity 0→1 .66s CustomEase 0.33,0,0,1, first photo turns off after .66s, on release the first photo returns immediately)
